newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Office Q1 hurt by lower paper prices.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Office Q1 hurt by lower paper prices.

text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corp on Monday said lower paper prices curtailed its revenue growth in the 1997 first quarter.
Significant paper price declines from the same quarter a year ago held back the company's revenue growth and operating expense leverage in the current quarter, the company said.

"Many analysts believe we have seen the bottom of the paper price cycle. The question now is the timing and magnitude of any paper price recovery," said Pete Danis, Boise Cascade Office president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
